digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate: necessity probe + bug review tier
propositions: The plan-review gate currently exempts all bug tickets to bare PASS without substantive review (verified on bug 5886: REVIEW_RESULT={runner:exempt, verdict:PASS, llm_calls:0}), yielding no screening on proposed changes.
FixedBench found 35-65% over-action results (plans that add mechanisms without establishing need) but the plan-review gate has no criterion to detect lack of justification, creating a detection gap.

A new advisory-only criterion 'necessity' (pass-1, 1-TURN judgment) must flag plans that do not demonstrate change is needed (no reproduction/motivation), accepting well-motivated and docs-only outcomes.
Bug tickets must be given a lightweight advisory-only review tier (DET floor + necessity probe, never blocking) instead of being short-circuited to exempt-PASS.
Piece (a) requires routing entry for necessity in criteria_routing.json with default_posture:advisory and no suppress_types:bug, plus registry and rubric additions.

Piece (b) requires modifying workflow_ops.plan_review_precheck to run DET floor and set run_llm:True for bugs, and restricting bug-tier criteria to BUG_TIER_CRITERIA=(necessity,) in assemble_criteria.
